subject: Physics
note: Optional AQA Physics Paper 3 Section B Option A only (35 marks). Pair with the compulsory 7408/3A (45 marks) for an 80-mark Paper 3 for a student taking this option. Do NOT sum multiple Section B options, or treat this optional section as compulsory for all students. This is source reference METADATA, not student-facing practice.
markingWarnings: 01.1 awards a combined mark for two distinct stellar-evolution identifications; scoring four diagram labels independently can over-award.
01.2 requires annotation on the HR diagram; typed text alone cannot verify the plotted position.
01.3 requires the transit mechanism and its application to a small planet; a contradictory description of directly seeing the planet is disallowed by the official scheme.
01.4 has five method/accuracy stages and allows specified error carried forward. Do not reduce to a single numerical keyword.
02.2 requires magnitude calculation and correct comparison with naked-eye visibility; a number alone may omit conclusion marks.
03 is a holistic six-mark levels-of-response answer involving three areas, not six independent keywords.
04.1 explanation credit depends on identifying the black hole, not a generic loss of emission.
04.2 contains a unit mark contingent on an attempted calculation; accept valid converted units only with correct conversion.
05.2 requires the wavelength-to-aperture resolution relationship, not just a claim that UV is better.
05.3 compares radio collecting power and spherical-aberration effects; the official scheme caps at two marks without a discussion of shape.
Paper mark scheme includes contradiction handling, appropriate numerical working and limited consequential credit; local auto-marking must be independently tested.
verification: All question-part numbers and bracketed marks cross-checked against official AQA 16-page November 2021 QP and 12-page final MS (the MS internally says June 2021). Editorial topics are original paraphrases. Source links are official AQA filestore.
